name: Omega no Shikai -Aki Kaketa Shiki no Ai-
original_name: Omegaの視界 アキかけたシキのアイ
source:
Main character heads for the northern countryside in order to investigate the mysterious group. One by one group members come to the stage, and soon protagonist is put before a terrible and cruel choice...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为了调查某个神秘团体，主人公动身前往北方的偏远乡间。随着团体成员接连登场，主人公也很快被逼入一场骇人而残酷的抉择面前……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
